# Brat Generator

> Brat Generator is a free, independent, browser-based suite for creating Brat-inspired text graphics, memes, images, album-cover-style artwork and animated text/video clips. The tools provide live previews, custom colour and typography controls, and downloadable exports without requiring an account.

Canonical website: https://bratgeneratorpro.net/
Primary language: English (en-GB)

Brat Generator is an independent fan-made project. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Charli XCX, Atlantic Records, Warner Music, or their related brands. References to the Brat aesthetic are descriptive and contextual.

## Core tools

- [Brat Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/): Main browser-based Brat text and graphic generator. Users can enter text, choose background and text colours, adjust text size, letter spacing and blur, switch between supported Brat-style modes, choose canvas dimensions, and export PNG, JPG or WebP files.
- [Brat Video Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/video-generator/): Creates animated Brat-style text and lyric clips. Users can enter line-by-line text, optionally add supported audio, preview the animation, adjust frame rate, and export browser-supported video, animated GIF, or a ZIP of PNG frames.
- [Brat Meme Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-meme-generator/): Creates Brat-style memes with top and bottom text, optional photo upload, background and text colours, blur and visual effects, social-ready canvas sizes, and image export.
- [Brat Image Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-image-generator/): Creates Brat-style graphics from custom text with optional uploaded backgrounds, colour controls, effects, multiple canvas ratios, and PNG/JPG/WebP export.
- [Brat Album Cover Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-album-cover-generator/): Creates square Brat-inspired album or playlist artwork with title and artist text, colour controls, blur, optional background images, live preview, and high-resolution export.
- [Brat Font Generator](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-font-generator/): Creates Brat-style typography with font choices, letter spacing, line height, alignment, blur, colour controls, transparent backgrounds, and PNG/JPG/WebP export.

## Examples

- [Brat Examples](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-examples/): Original Brat-style design examples and reusable starting points that can open the main generator with matching text, style, and colour settings.

## Styles

- [Brat Styles](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/brat-styles/): Visual guide to Brat Green, Black, White, Pink, Electric Blue, and custom-colour treatments. Selecting a style opens the main generator and applies the closest supported generator mode or matching colour preset.
- [Classic Brat Green preset](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#green): Opens the main generator with the classic green direction.
- [Black preset](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#black): Opens the main generator with a black background and light text.
- [White preset](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#white): Opens the main generator and selects the matching white generator mode.
- [Pink preset](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#pink): Opens the main generator with the pink palette.
- [Blue preset](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#blue): Opens the main generator with the electric-blue palette.

## Tutorials and guides

- [Homepage How to Use section](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/#how-to): Detailed four-step workflow with step visuals covering text entry, colour choice, typography and export.
- [Brat Generator Help](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/): Help hub for practical tutorials and troubleshooting articles.
- [How to Make a Brat Album Cover Free](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/how-to-make-a-brat-album-cover-free/): Practical album-cover guide covering Brat Green, condensed typography, controlled blur, four-step creation and platform-oriented canvas sizes.
- [Brat Generator Not Working? Common Problems & Quick Fixes](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-generator-not-working/): Focused troubleshooting guide for downloads, excessive blur, clipped text, colour differences and mobile download locations.
- [Brat Video Export Guide: Video vs GIF vs PNG Frames](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-video-export-guide/): Explains browser-supported video export, silent GIF loops and PNG frame ZIPs, including audio, quality and editing trade-offs.
- [Brat Video Tips: Text Length, Timing, FPS & Better Motion](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-video-tips/): Practical guidance for readable moving text, line sequencing, 10–60 FPS choices, audio compatibility, previews and browser-friendly rendering.
- [Brat Video Audio Sync & Supported Formats](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-video-audio-sync-formats/): Explains browser-friendly audio formats, line timing, audio trimming, preview sync, and common decoding or export problems.
- [Brat Meme Ideas & Templates You Can Create](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-meme-ideas-templates/): Original meme-format ideas, writing patterns, background choices and canvas recommendations for Brat-style meme creation.
- [Which Brat Generator Tool Should You Use?](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/which-brat-tool-should-you-use/): Compares the main, font, meme, image, video and album-cover workflows so visitors can choose the tool that matches their project.
- [Brat Canvas Size Guide: Square vs Portrait vs Story vs Wide](https://bratgeneratorpro.net/help/brat-canvas-size-guide/): Explains the site’s square, portrait, vertical Story, wide and album-cover canvas sizes and how to avoid awkward stretching or crops.

## Important implementation notes

- The canonical hostname is `https://bratgeneratorpro.net` without `www`.
- Indexable page URLs use trailing slashes.
- Retired routes such as `/brat-text-generator/`, `/how-to-use/`, and `/features/` redirect to their current homepage destinations and are intentionally omitted from the XML sitemap.
- The main image-generation workflows render the active design in the browser. User-created generator content is not required to be uploaded to an application server for normal image export.
- The default Brat Green preset uses `#8ACE00` as a practical digital approximation. Display appearance can vary by screen and colour profile.
- For legal, commercial-use, rights, or affiliation questions, use the Terms & Disclaimer and About pages as the primary references.
